1.why: Clear sans-serif typography with standard spacing is used throughout the interface.

2.why: Interface text avoids italics, dense text blocks, and full capitalization.

3.why: The layout is displayed in a centered card desktop view rather than a native mobile screen format.

4.why: Instructions across all screens use short, plain language.

5.why: Input fields lack example formats or placeholder text showing expected inputs.

6.why: Main user guidance is brief and avoids long descriptive paragraphs.

7.why: No dedicated copy buttons are provided for the Base32 secret or recovery codes.

8.why: The setup step provides only a plain text secret without a QR code graphic option.

9.why: Standard form fields exist, though visual screenshots cannot confirm browser autofill integration.

10.why: Primary action buttons are styled in prominent blue to highlight the main step.

11.why: Each workflow screen focuses on one central primary task.

12.why: Status updates appear in system logs, though explicit user-facing next-step guidance is minimal.

13.why: Users can regenerate recovery codes and navigate screens without visible penalty.

14.why: No active error validation states or non-blaming error messages are shown in the provided flow.

15.why: No countdown timers or strict time limits are visible on any step.
